task: For the item below answer ONE question: does the candidate quote actually EXPRESS the extracted condition text? Judge from the quoted words themselves. Do NOT assume the extracted condition is correct - it is the thing under test, produced by an automated extractor that may overstate or add claims the speaker never made. Every clause of the condition must be supported for CONFIRMED; if some clauses are supported and others are not, that is PARTIAL and you must name the unsupported clauses.

dispositions.CONFIRMED: the quote expresses the whole condition, every clause
dispositions.PARTIAL: some clauses supported, others not - name which are unsupported
dispositions.DENIED: real text, but does not support the condition
dispositions.UNRESOLVED: cannot be decided from the quoted words alone
